title: Cargo transporters’ strike in Maputo province and Nampula (December 2020 boundary lead)
reason: The documented gathering occurred on 2020-12-02, before the January 2021 unit month, so it is not included as a January event. Core reported grievances concern employment conditions and employer relations. VOA also reports one driver objecting to fines for mechanical faults, which could imply a policy grievance; the responsible authority and exact target are unresolved. The cited 19 arrests do not establish that at least 50 people gathered.
notes: This item is retained as a prior-month boundary lead. VOA reports an organizer promising continuation, but no January occurrence was established in this pass; this does not prove that the wider labor dispute or any activity ended.
